purpose: Final whole-family transfer gate after family-v1 post-hoc diagnosis removed three benchmark category errors: native physical truth is not Security merely because Security runs the experiment; Web projection ownership is not browser/local execution proof; the Human repository is not the human respondent.

treatments.compact_family: Computing owns cross-project synthesis, not product truth. Host owns durable semantic Task/commitment/verification continuity. Harness owns one bounded Agent Run and opaque Provider/Tool continuation, while semantic reasoning stays with the semantic judge. Runtime proves local Workspace/Job/process/Artifact execution and not external effects. World owns narrow external correlation/trajectory/evidence-mapping semantics and may persist World extension state through Host; external providers/source/destination systems keep native physical occurrence/currentness. Finance owns Finance-local capital/evidence/effect/reconciliation/accounting semantics, derives Finance assessments from venue evidence, and leaves venue occurrence to the venue and investment meaning to the semantic judge. Security owns Security-local Range/authority/information/evaluator contracts; independent physical Range truth is still external/native truth, not a backend receipt. Game owns Game-local world/rules/planning/action-admission semantics and native registered game state; fun/replacement is a semantic judgment, and accepted v3 target evidence does not silently replace registered v2. Human owns Human-local admitted research questions/methods/framework limits; the Human project is not authority over the person. Studio owns a creative expression/production seam and derives source-bound artifacts/grounded observations; it does not own source facts or human response merely because an Agent observer learned from an artifact. Web owns public projection/publication judgment and derives dated public surfaces from owner sources; it does not become the mechanical browser executor or owner product truth. Local/domain semantic home, classical implementation and shared promotion remain independent; generic mechanisms are not promoted without repeated materially different consumers and residual non-bypassable responsibility.
treatments.role_pure_family_relations: Answer only the exact named relation. Use `OWNER_NATIVE_SOURCE` when the authoritative fact is an Ordivon project's own canonical state/source; use `NATIVE_EXTERNAL_SYSTEM` when it is an independently authoritative provider, physical Range, venue, source/destination domain or other external system. `SEMANTIC_JUDGE` means the person/Agent/domain evaluator responsible for meaning/acceptance; it is never the Human repository merely because humans are involved. Project labels such as HUMAN/STUDIO/WEB/SECURITY name project-owned contracts or derivations, not generic people/domains. World state semantics may PERSIST_VIA Host without Host taking World semantics. Harness Provider continuation is structural Run state, not cognition. Runtime proves local execution, not external occurrence. Security may admit/evaluate adversarial experiments while independent Range/Host/QMP/netlink evidence remains native physical truth. Game native registered state is owner-native source truth while playability is semantic judgment and target lifecycle remains explicit. Studio maps source evidence into expression and grounded observations while human-response acceptance requires a semantic judge. Web maps owner sources into public projection and judges public no-op/change, while browser execution is delegated/mechanical. Computing synthesis never replaces owner source truth. Semantic home, mechanical delegation and shared promotion are separate relations.

cases.scenario: Computing derives one cross-project claim from current owner evidence. A product repository later changes its own canonical state.
Host stores a semantic checkpoint that references Runtime Job J; later we need current execution state for J.
Harness persists an opaque Gemini Tool continuation signature across restart while keeping it outside Agent-visible cognition.
Runtime proves local process P ran. P may have contacted a payment provider; only the provider can prove payment occurrence.
World defines a provider correlation record and stores it via Host extension CAS; the provider later supplies the native Receipt that World maps into Host evidence.
Finance owns exact client-order/effect identity after an ambiguous venue write; Runtime proves the local attempt and the venue proves order occurrence.
Security admits an adversarial Range action. The backend returns success, but independent Host/QMP/netlink observation is the evidence for what physically happened.
Security IF3 removes a mandatory finalization/readback ceremony in one exact consumer without reintroducing the undesired activation.
The registered Game reducer proves a legal Station Zero terminal state; people then judge whether the encounter is understandable and fun.
Game v3 has accepted target evidence for action admission but remains absent from the current product registry.
A Human research framework survives its admitted structural/case audit. A person asks whether it thereby authorizes a specific high-consequence action for them.
No real Human trajectory has exposed a new missing mechanism after HUMAN-ECON-001, but someone proposes an automatic successor taxonomy cycle.
Studio derives an evidence-grounded semantic observation from a Runtime-owned source artifact; the Runtime fact itself remains source-owned.
A Studio Agent-observer experiment shows artifact-bound knowledge transfer. The next claim asks whether humans understand or trust the artifact.
Studio fine semantic labels drift across observers while evidence grounding remains stable; someone proposes a universal semantic ontology service.
A project implementation changes but Web's owner-declared public judgment stays the same, so Web rebinds the exact dependency and chooses a public no-op.
A browser tool proves screenshot bytes and HTTP success for a Web candidate. A separate human evaluation asks whether the information architecture is understandable.
Web stores public publication semantics while the project's current implementation facts remain in that project's owner repository.
Finance and Security both use Runtime for local execution, but their domain policies remain materially different. A new shared policy engine is proposed solely because both call Runtime.
A generic numerical library, database or scheduler already owns the complete mechanical need while the consuming domain keeps its own semantics.
